newsitem.title: USA: Demand, low rates keep U.S corp bond supply coming.
newsitem.headline: Demand, low rates keep U.S corp bond supply coming.

text.p: Corporate bond new issue activity is expected to continue at a steady rate as strong buyside demand and lower interest rates continue to spur U.S. corporations to tap the primary market, dealers said.
The newest player to appear is Mead Corp which is expected to issue a $550 million multi-tranche debt offering, according to syndicate sources.
"The name Mead is in the market with a four-part deal consisting of a five, 20, 40 and 50-year maturities, said one high-grade syndicate source.
Sources said the 40-year Mead tranche carries a put option in the tenth year.
Also, on the new issue agenda is a $700 million investment-grade corporate bond offering from Sherwin-Williams Co via Salomon Brothers Inc, sources added.
Market sources say the company will sell $100 million of three-year bonds, $100 million of five-year bonds and $200 million of 10-year bonds in a public deal.
Details on the remainder, which will be sold privately, were not available.
In the high-yield sector this week, another $125 million is expected to be brought to market by Advanced Radio Telecom Corp.
The company is expected to sell 10-year senior notes via Merrill Lynch & Co. Price talk on the issue is in the area of 13.25 to 13.50 percent, sources said.
Renaissance Cosmetics is expected to tap the private placement market with $125 million in 144A senior subordinated notes due 2007 via Bear Stearns & Co, also one day this week.

Looking ahead, International CableTel Inc is expected to tap the private placement market with $300 million in 10-year 144A senior notes and $100 million in 144A preferreds due 2009 via Donaldson Lufkin and Jenrette Securities, syndicate sources said.
Also, TCI Satellite Entertainment will bring its $350 million two-part debut debt offering via joint lead managers Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities and Merrill Lynch.
